description: Classifies inline AME-range literals in computations/*.py as SAFE (byte-exact to a codata_constants registry export → value-preserving route) vs UNSAFE (near but not exact → routing changes the value). The registry's last-digit conventions differ from many corpus literals, so the fvxq tail is not a uniform sweep. SAFE = the routing work; UNSAFE = value-reconciliation decisions that must precede any route.
note: Routing + per-file run-verification (the fvxq value-preservation discipline) is infra-gated in some sandboxes: many target files import pyhecke_native (buildable, ~42s) or have pre-existing runtime errors. This triage (pure string compare) runs anywhere and is the roadmap.
